events.title: Vergesig Farm Annual Harvest Festival
events.description:
Join us on Vergesig Farm in the beautiful Piket-Bo-Berg for our annual Harvest Festival — a joyful celebration of the season’s harvest.
We are a family-run, certified organic and biodynamic farm growing apples and pears with care for the soil and the earth. Each year, as the harvest draws to a close, we open our gates to share the magic of farm life with our community.
Come enjoy a full day on the farm with apple picking, tractor rides, games, candle making, face painting, farm tours, and visits to our friendly chickens and cows. Families and young children are warmly welcome.
